method: Original pixels of all 11 finish views and six world-context frames inspected before clearance metadata. Scores are subjective judgments for the compact game asset.

boundedCorrection.pixelFinding: Strong alternating clay and slate colors produce a regular checkerboard. In clay the course relief is almost absent, so the major roof reads as a printed grid rather than layered roofing. This dominates the front, rear, top and both obliques.
boundedCorrection.hypothesis: Reduce adjacent hue/value contrast, break parity repetition, and use staggered courses with a subtle visible lower lip/shadow. Apply consistently to main, dormer and annex roofing.
boundedCorrection.controls: Keep approved roof silhouette/envelope, attachments, house proportions and assembly transform frozen. No unrelated finish expansion.
boundedCorrection.requiredDelta: Roof material/readability at least 0.86 (+0.10); every critical view/category at least 0.85; no critical regression above 0.05.

cottage-world-azimuth-0.finding: Conifer removed from annex/terrace. Main and annex doors are unobstructed; furniture stays outside door panels and approach.

cottage-world-azimuth-90.limitation: Neighbor partially occludes annex; projected overlap alone is not collision proof.

cottage-world-azimuth-180.finding: Rear service-door threshold visibly clear of prior rock intrusion; terrace remains supported by coastline.

cottage-world-azimuth-270.limitation: Lighthouse obscures lower cottage; evaluated only exposed upper contacts.

cottage-world-azimuth-45.finding: Elevated view supplies visible lighthouse gap and separate annex/neighbor volumes.

cottage-world-azimuth-135.finding: Opposite elevated view corroborates neighboring roof separation and supported rear terrace.

assembly.diagnosticMetadata: clearance-after.json reports no rear terrain ray hits and annex eave at neighbor-local x about -0.853, y about 1.138 versus wall x -0.71. Actual neighbor gutter lies above the annex eave. The approximate neighborRoofMinX value is not acceptance authority; original elevated and cardinal pixels govern this gate.
assembly.scope: Assembly accepted separately. Roof finish remains unapproved. Recheck assembly if the roof envelope or placement changes.

remainingTargetGaps: Beyond the failed roof course reading, timber and plaster remain regular with limited weathering. Target is inferred; exact cinematic parity is not claimed.
